{{Top}}
'''Diseases''' were [[Virus (disambiguation)|viruses]] or other organisms that attacked the immune systems of [[Species/Legends|living creatures]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Examples of diseases included [[Cardooine Chills]], [[Krytos virus]], [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and [[Falsin's rot]].<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

A living creature could be infected by a disease in a number of ways, such as coming into contact with another infected creature, touching diseased matter, consuming food or drink tainted with disease, or being the victim of a [[Bioweapon/Legends|biological weapon]] attack. All living creatures had an immune system that was able to fight off infection which could lead to recovery. However, in severe cases medical treatment was required.<ref name="Revised Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

If left untreated, a disease could wreak havoc on a being. Depending on the type and severity, diseases could bring about unconsciousness, the [[Dismemberment/Legends|loss of a limb]], or [[Death/Legends|death]].
